title: $32 warrant exercise window closed
mechanism: Expiration removes unexercised warrants as a future contingent supply outlet, strengthening the constrained-supply side of the squeeze thesis. It does not establish realized supply because aggregate exercises and resulting issuance have not been disclosed.
observations: GameStop’s $32 warrants expired at 5:00 p.m. New York time on October 30; unexercised warrants became worthless.
GME WS ceased trading before the October 30 market open.
Guaranteed-delivery users had to submit notice and cash by the expiration deadline and may deliver warrants through November 2; aggregate exercises and issuance remain unknown.
stateEffect: The prospective warrant-supply gate falls away, but stale short positioning and unavailable current market, options, borrow, and covering evidence keep the exact state at Dormant/Low.
